title: The Widow's Mites
description: Jesus sits directly opposite the temple treasury and watches how people put money into it. Many rich people give large amounts. Then a poor widow comes and puts in two small coins. Jesus calls his disciples to him and says: 'Truly, I tell you: This poor widow has given more than all the others who put money into the temple treasury. For they all gave out of their surplus, but she gave out of her poverty—everything she had, all she had to live on.'

versions.title: The Widow's Mites
versions.description: Jesus sits directly opposite the temple offering box and watches people putting in their gifts. Many rich people give large amounts. Then a poor widow comes and puts in two small mites. Jesus calls his disciples to him and says: 'Truly, I tell you: This poor widow has given more than all the others. For they gave out of their surplus, but she gave out of her poverty everything she owned, all she had to live on.'
